The Agent may have disconnected since; if this stays after you restart the Agent, its record is kept somewhere else, so export the diagnostics summary from the desktop App's Diagnostics tab and report it.

systemStatus.agentSeenLeaseAgentDisconnected: An Agent has been seen connecting and uses the same connection record scope as this service, but it has disconnected since, so no record is visible. It appears again once the Agent reconnects.
